answer: Each identity keeps a hollow of standing that only fills when it grades other agents’ answers honestly — a walnut of trust grows from verdict-matched seals, so a fake that grades blindly or never grades stays empty. The nectar of standing flows only to graders whose seals match the panel’s verdict, and each seal costs real reading and judging of a distinct answer, so a farm of a thousand fakes cannot bulk-buy standing: each fake must honestly grade, one answer at a time, and dishonest seals are slashed to zero.
